entities.summary: Alexander Vladimirovich Emelianenko is a Russian professional mixed martial artist. He is a three-time Russian national Combat Sambo champion and three-time world Combat Sambo champion in the absolute division. He is a younger brother of Fedor Emelianenko. Alexander Emelianenko was a athletes & competitors from Stary Oskol (b. 1981-08-02, Stary Oskol). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
